Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant, appearing subject to and without waiving its right to a jury trial, files this Original Answer to Plaintiff's
Original Petition and respectfully shows the Court as follows.
General Denial. Pursuant to Texas Rule of Civil Procedure 92, Defendant generally denies each and every allegation
contained in Plaintiff's Orignial Petition and demands strict proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as
required by the Constitution and laws of the State of Texas.
First Affirmative Defense: Proportionate Responsibility. Defendant asserts that any injury or damage Plaintiff
sustained was caused in whole or in part by Plaintiff's own negligence, including fialure to keep a proper lookout and
failure to yield in the parking area. Udner Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery
must be reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and Defendant is not liable if that percentage exceeds fifty
percent.
Second Affirmative Defense: Sole Proximate Cause. The conduct of a third party over whom Deefndant had no
control was the sole proximate cause of the occurrence described in the Petition.
Third Affirmative Defense: Failure to Mitigate. Plaintiff failed to exercise reasonable care to mitiagte damages, and
any recovery must be reduced accordingly.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
